caveats: Timezone-less GDACS ISO dates interpreted as UTC; t_minutes uses polygondate (product update timestamp), falling back to episode todate. All episodes retain source fromdate/todate; April 1 revisions remain in the requested period.
Source estimated burned areas and alert levels are not official Korean damage totals.
Missing population remains null; polygons are preserved in raw geometry files.
